summary.text: Aisha Dew is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 107, which she has represented since 2025, and is the only candidate listed for the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Aisha O. Dew earned a bachelor's degree from Salem College in 2000.
Her career experience includes working as a consultant.
She succeeded Robert Drakeford in the state House.
